ChooseVideo.DialogText: Suite has detected that you are using an HD radio. But the video component version is missing. Please confirm your video component version carefully by following the bitmaps below.

DialogBootloaderGuide.BootloaderGuideTitle: Your firmware may not support auto switching. Please switch to bootloader manually by following the steps
DialogBootloaderGuide.BootloaderGuideStep1: Unplug the USB cable and turn off your radio
DialogBootloaderGuide.BootloaderGuideStep2: Press POWER while holding ENTER until you see "bootloader"
DialogBootloaderGuide.BootloaderGuideStep3: Connect your radio to the computer and you will see "USB connected"

DialogFirmwareGuide.FirmwareGuideTitle: Your bootloader may not support auto switching. Please switch to firmware manually by following the steps
DialogFirmwareGuide.FirmwareGuideStep1: Unplug the USB cable and turn off the bootloader
DialogFirmwareGuide.FirmwareGuideStep2: Turn on your radio normally and wait until preflight check finished
DialogFirmwareGuide.FirmwareGuideStep3: Connect your radio to the computer and select "FrSky Suite" from the pop-up menu

DialogFrskGuide.FrskGuideTitle: Auto flashing did not start successfully. Please flash the .frsk manually by following the steps
DialogFrskGuide.FrskGuideStep1: Unplug the USB cable and enter the system - file manager menu
DialogFrskGuide.FrskGuideStep2: Find the device.frsk file in NAND or SD card tab
DialogFrskGuide.FrskGuideStep3: Flash your device by selecting the option in the pop-up menu

DialogFlashGuide.FlashGuideTitle: Auto flashing did not start successfully. Please finish it manually by following the steps
DialogFlashGuide.FlashGuideStep: Your firmware.bin is ready. Just unplug the USB cable and the flashing will start

DialogNandBootloaderGuide.NandBootloaderGuideTitle: Your bootloader is out of date. Please flash the bootloader manually by following the steps
DialogNandBootloaderGuide.NandBootloaderGuideStep1: Make sure your computer has the DFU driver installed correctly
DialogNandBootloaderGuide.NandBootloaderGuideStep2: Visit GitHub to download the bootloader of your corresponding radio
DialogNandBootloaderGuide.NandBootloaderGuideStep4: Go to the DFU flasher, select the bootloader.frsk you just downloaded and click "Flash"
